lines.text: The sons of the prophets tell Elisha their meeting place is too small and ask to go to the Jordan.
Elisha agrees to go with them, and at the Jordan they begin cutting down trees.
As one man cuts a tree, the iron axe head falls into the water, and he says it was borrowed.
Elisha asks where it fell, cuts a rope, throws it there, and makes the iron float.
He tells the man to lift the floating iron out, and the man reaches out his foot and takes it.
